::: {#hero-heading}
<div class="h1">Hey, I'm happy you're here</div>

Thanks for stopping by! 

I work as a research assistant at the [NTID Research Center on Culture and Language](https://www.rit.edu/ntid/research-center-culture-and-language) at the Rochester Institute of Technology. My research intrests inlcude utilizing data 
to improve educational outcomes for Deaf and Hard of Hearing students.

My current project with the NTID Research Center on Culture and Language aims to develop standardized assestment tools in American Sign Language to evaulate and screen for Alzheimer's disease and dementia in Deaf and Hard of Hearing Older Adults. Learn more about our work [here](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41642783/). 

Connect with me on [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/emmamkane).
:::

<!-- end grid -->

**Featured Research Projects** 

- **Language and Cognition (LAC) Project (2024-Present)**
Create and validate neuropsychological assessment tools in American Sign Language to screen for dementia and Alzheimer's disease for Deaf and Hard of Hearing older adults. 
- **Access to Research Support for Deaf and Hard of Hearing Students (2026)**
Evaluate the accessibility of research-related reosurces and support for Deaf and Hard of Hearing students at the Rochester Institute of Technology. 
- **Reproductive Health Experiences of Deaf and Hard of Hearing Individuals (2023-2026)**
Evaluate the reproductive health experiences of Deaf and Hard of Hearing individuals and provide recommendations to improve access to reproductive health care and education for Deaf and Hard of Hearing individuals.

:::
